description: Detects missing ownership checks, broken role enforcement, and IDOR vulnerabilities that let users access other users' resources. Use when writing code that checks authorization, enforces resource ownership, handles IDOR (object-level authorization), processes server-side requests to external URLs, or implements access control middleware.
